title: PlanetBintang REIC Tables · Kamus Digital
description: Logical table contract for the Kamus Digital account, dictionary collections and File Manager. The current GitHub Pages client stores these records in browser IndexedDB; this schema is the migration contract for a server-side REIC API.
securityRequirements: Password verification and password hashing must run server-side for production accounts; never expose password hashes or salts to public read APIs.
Enforce ownership checks on every collection, history, settings, file and audit query using the authenticated userId.
Issue opaque, short-lived sessions; store only token hashes server-side; support revocation and rate limiting.
Validate uploads by size, MIME sniffing and file policy; store binary objects outside the Git repository.
Admin roles must be assigned only by a trusted server-side administrator.
Do not use GitHub Pages, public JSON files, localStorage or IndexedDB as the authority for production identity or cross-device cloud storage.

apiContract.POST /api/reic/auth/register: Create a user; server hashes password and returns session.
apiContract.GET|POST /api/reic/collections: List or save dictionary entries for current user.
apiContract.GET|POST /api/reic/files: List or upload files for current user.
apiContract.GET|PATCH /api/reic/settings: Read or update current user's settings.
apiContract.GET /api/reic/audit: Read own activity; admin views require server authorization.
